issues.description: The four SAS programs hard-code [redacted-path-bdc8701c251b] and [redacted-path-c84ddf6964b0] input, output and macro paths. The accrual producer writes ddrive2.disc_accruals under [redacted-path-f60c30d6fabc], while the three downstream programs point ddrive2 at [redacted-path-ef97545ba2f3]; for a single sequential local run, all consumers must read the same generated table from the producer’s configured output library. The packaged WT macro must also replace each external include path.

The local COMP.FUNDA candidate has `sich` rather than the exact `sic` used by all four programs; the accrual program additionally tests `seo` and `small_loss` for missing values without constructing them, and these exact columns are absent from the candidate. Confirm the author extract fields and whether `sich` is the intended source for `sic`; do not guess a mapping or manufacture the two additional fields. The author-named historical extracts could have a different schema.

The supplied MATLAB settings force n4=0, so the script does not reach the documented nonzero-correlation cases. The appendix specifies Figure A2 at R13^2=0.20 with all pairwise correlations positive, and Figure A3 at R13^2=0.20 with x1/x3 negative and the other correlations positive. Configure these as separate variants while preserving the current zero-correlation baseline; the target parameters are documented and do not require author clarification.

The simulation uses randn for noise and generated regressors but has no explicit rng seed. The code remains attemptable; for exact numerical comparison, record the runtime default/seed behavior or use a documented tolerance. The supplied procedure gives no seed.

The MATLAB script computes workspace arrays and mean matrices but contains no plot/save/export routine in the supplied 97 lines. The online appendix identifies simulation Figures A1–A3. Request the intended plotting/export steps and map the arrays to the reported figure outputs.

Three packaged Heat Map workbooks contain bounded-preview triangular matrices labeled by fyear with numeric entries, but no supplied code reads them and the datasheet/appendix do not describe their production or use. Clarify whether these are final result artifacts, plot inputs/templates, or unrelated support files; do not treat them as mandatory raw inputs without that contract.

The accrual ddrive2 path is [redacted-path-c84ddf6964b0] while the three consumers point to [redacted-path-bdc8701c251b], so local path configuration must unify them.

The export is produced but no supplied Stata consumer exists; the datasheet names SAS for the application regressions.

The sample-identifiers workbook is an optional reference with datadate/cusip identifiers, not an analysis input; it is not read by code and no CUSIP-to-GVKEY crosswalk/manual GUI stage is provided. Do not make it a mandatory raw input.

No author URL for data or code acquisition appears in the supplied datasheet/code. No public Compustat acquisition route or missing entitlement is inferred.
No author programs, regressions, or simulations were executed; no source files were edited; execution_verified remains false.

Investment-history QA is derivable from source: the investment script merges a residual at a preceding date and drops missing residuals; the accrual producer is restricted to fyear 1996–2015. Future execution should record the retained investment date range, but this is not an extra author-clarification gate.

Investment code references `constant` only when constructing fy_constant interactions that are not included in the displayed PROC REG model. Under a local source without `constant`, this is an output-schema QA note; no author clarification or code repair is required to attempt the supplied regression.
